zh-CN.settings.advanced.title: 高级设置
zh-CN.settings.advanced.description: 这里列出节点全局与控制面的有效值、启动配置来源和不支持原因。当前版本不渲染伪开关；事务性编辑、差异应用与回滚由后续配置接口统一提供。
zh-CN.settings.advanced.listen_addresses.detai: 当前 P2P 套接字使用双栈通配监听；本版本没有可由产品界面设置的绑定地址。
zh-CN.settings.advanced.interface_allowlist.de: 接口白名单/黑名单尚未接入；当前由平台路由与 TUN 策略决定流量路径。
zh-CN.settings.advanced.dns_mode.detail: GlobalProxy 与 BypassMainland 使用本地 DoH 桥；MeshOnly 保留系统解析器。模式尚未提供独立覆盖项。
zh-CN.settings.advanced.doh_upstreams.detail: 上游由启动环境配置控制，默认包含公共 DoH 解析器；安全快照不暴露原始环境值。
zh-CN.settings.advanced.dot.detail: DoT 后端尚未接入；不能把 DoH 状态误报成 DoT 可用。
zh-CN.settings.advanced.dns_leak.detail: 受支持的 Linux 代理路径会锁定并备份 resolv.conf；泄漏验证与统一策略配置尚未接入。
zh-CN.settings.advanced.nat_detection.detail: STUN/NAT 检测由逐网络启动配置控制；当前安全快照未投影具体探测参数。
zh-CN.settings.advanced.resource_limits.detail: Exit、Relay、Coordinator 的资源上限、带宽配额、连接数和允许目标尚未接入高级设置。
zh-CN.settings.advanced.webui_listener.detail: 监听地址、证书和来源策略由启动配置控制；公网暴露必须由所有者在部署层显式开启。
zh-CN.settings.advanced.webui_session.detail: Passkey 登录；会话保存在 HttpOnly、SameSite=Strict Cookie 中。有效期尚无可编辑项。
zh-CN.settings.advanced.webui_rate_limit.detai: 登录失败与 mutation 使用运行时代码限流；阈值尚不可配置。
zh-CN.settings.advanced.hsts.detail: 仅在可信 HTTPS 边界输出 HSTS；不会在普通 HTTP 或未经确认的代理链路上伪造该响应头。
zh-CN.settings.advanced.trusted_proxy.detail: 可信代理列表来自启动配置；界面尚不提供编辑入口。
zh-CN.settings.advanced.log_retention.detail: 日志保留周期、远程日志和隐私脱敏策略尚未接入。
zh-CN.settings.advanced.metrics.detail: 指标端点尚未接入；不暴露伪指标地址。
zh-CN.settings.advanced.updates.detail: 更新通道、代理、签名校验与回滚尚未接入。
zh-CN.settings.advanced.maintenance.detail: 计划维护窗口尚未接入。

en.owner_auth.login.title: Node owner sign in
en.owner_auth.login.description: Verify the node owner with a registered passkey. The session is stored only in an HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict cookie; this page never reads or persists access tokens.
en.owner_auth.login.help: Passkeys require a trusted HTTPS address or http://localhost. If the browser reports a certificate or domain error before the page loads, fix the certificate and WebAuthn origin; the app never provides a verification bypass.
en.owner_auth.issue.secure_context: This page is not a trusted WebAuthn secure context. Use the configured public HTTPS address or http://localhost. Certificate and domain errors must be fixed; verification cannot be bypassed.
en.owner_auth.issue.passkey_unsupported: This browser or platform does not support the required passkey capabilities. Use a modern browser and system authenticator with WebAuthn support.
en.owner_auth.issue.origin_mismatch: The WebAuthn address does not match. Expected {expected}, current {actual}. Open {expected}; if the browser reports a certificate error, fix the certificate instead of bypassing verification.
en.owner_auth.web_identity.detail: The public WebUI uses passkeys and an HttpOnly same-origin session. Session state is shown only inside the WebUI.

en.settings.advanced.title: Advanced settings
en.settings.advanced.description: This inventory reports effective node-global and control-plane values, startup-config sources, and unsupported reasons. This build does not draw inert switches; transactional editing, diff apply, and rollback belong to the later configuration API.
en.settings.advanced.listen_addresses.detai: The current P2P socket uses a wildcard dual-stack listener. This build has no product-controlled bind address.
en.settings.advanced.interface_allowlist.de: Interface allowlists and denylists are not connected; platform routing and TUN policy currently choose the traffic path.
en.settings.advanced.dns_mode.detail: GlobalProxy and BypassMainland use the local DoH bridge; MeshOnly keeps the host resolver. The mode has no independent override yet.
en.settings.advanced.doh_upstreams.detail: Upstreams are controlled by startup environment configuration and default to public DoH resolvers. The safe snapshot does not expose the raw environment value.
en.settings.advanced.dot.detail: The DoT backend is not connected; DoH availability must not be reported as DoT support.
en.settings.advanced.dns_leak.detail: Supported Linux proxy paths lock and back up resolv.conf. Leak verification and unified policy configuration are not connected yet.
en.settings.advanced.nat_detection.detail: STUN/NAT detection is controlled by per-network startup configuration; the current safe snapshot does not project probe details.
en.settings.advanced.resource_limits.detail: Resource ceilings, bandwidth quotas, connection counts, and allowed targets for Exit, Relay, and Coordinator are not connected to advanced settings.
en.settings.advanced.webui_listener.detail: Listener, certificate, and origin policy come from startup configuration. Public exposure must be explicitly enabled by the owner at deployment.
en.settings.advanced.webui_session.detail: Passkey login; sessions use an HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict cookie. Expiry is not editable yet.
en.settings.advanced.webui_rate_limit.detai: Login failures and mutations use fixed runtime rate limits; thresholds are not configurable yet.
en.settings.advanced.hsts.detail: HSTS is emitted only at a verified HTTPS boundary; it is never fabricated for plain HTTP or an unverified proxy chain.
en.settings.advanced.trusted_proxy.detail: The trusted proxy list comes from startup configuration; the UI has no editor yet.
en.settings.advanced.log_retention.detail: Log retention, remote shipping, and privacy redaction policy are not connected.
en.settings.advanced.metrics.detail: The metrics endpoint is not connected; no placeholder address is exposed.
en.settings.advanced.updates.detail: Update channels, proxies, signature verification, and rollback are not connected.
en.settings.advanced.maintenance.detail: Scheduled maintenance windows are not connected.
